details: The U.S. Senate is progressing with the CLARITY Act, aiming to establish a comprehensive regulatory framework for digital assets. The revised bill, which includes ethics rules for officials and protections for developers and customers, could resolve regulatory uncertainties and potentially end the "crypto winter" if passed before the August recess. This bipartisan effort signals a significant step towards clearer guidelines for the crypto sector.
title: US Senate Advances CLARITY Act, Eyes Regulatory Framework for Crypto

details: Bitcoin has maintained its position above $65,000, recovering from recent volatility. This stabilization is supported by a sixth consecutive session of net inflows into spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), with funds attracting approximately $779 million since July 13. Analysts note a key resistance level for BTC around $68,000, which could test its upward momentum.
title: Bitcoin Stabilizes Above $65K Amid Sustained Spot ETF Inflows

details: Spot Ethereum ETFs are experiencing a notable reversal, attracting $196.4 million in net inflows between July 14 and July 21, 2026. This resurgence in institutional capital, largely led by BlackRock's ETHA, follows months of outflows and is seen as a positive indicator for Ethereum's potential future rallies and increased integration with traditional financial infrastructure.
title: Ethereum ETFs See Renewed Institutional Inflows, Reversing Trend

details: The SEC has issued a warning that crypto vaults and certain lending strategies may fall under federal securities laws. Commissioner Hester Peirce emphasized that the varying features and evolving strategies of these vaults require careful analysis to determine if they implicate existing securities regulations. This signals increased scrutiny and potential regulatory challenges in the decentralized finance (DeFi) space.
title: SEC Warns Crypto Vaults May Fall Under Securities Laws
